title: Forest Glade
description: Forage through a sun-dappled forest glade. Gather berries, herbs, and mushrooms while dodging rocks and thornbushes.
detailedDescription: Wander through a serene woodland glade bathed in golden sunlight, foraging for nature's bounty. Berries, medicinal herbs, and rare mushrooms are scattered across the forest floor â€” collect them while avoiding rocks, thornbushes, and startled wildlife. Between foraging runs, visit your campsite to upgrade your basket capacity, sharpen your senses to spot rare items, and unlock new forest areas. Each run is timed but the atmosphere remains calm and inviting.
controls: Arrow keys or WASD to move. Walk over items to collect them. Avoid obstacles. Return to camp with enough items to unlock upgrades.
